mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the breathing lungs to circulation brought the parts together: the picture traces oxygen from the lungs to tissues and blood back to the heart.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed circuit connection was confusing because the lung capillaries already seemed ready to join the blood route. The later goal explained when the connection became available.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the circuit could not connect to the lung exchange surface until the breathing apparatus was complete.

arbitrary.text: The required timing of the circuit connection felt somewhat arbitrary: the earlier picture showed capillaries beside the air sacs, but did not explain why the circuit could not yet join them.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter. Seeing the separate constructions form a route that serves distant cells made me curious how the remaining body systems would join it.
